in_marathi.name: Shivani
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shivani हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Shivani is a feminine form of Shiva, the Hindu god of destruction and creation. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'shivana', which means 'friendly to Shiva'.
